title: Lucerne Guest Experience Initiative Kickoff
author: ahmed.benali@alpenblick.com
content: The Lucerne Guest Experience Initiative was officially kicked off on June 1st. Owner: Ahmed Ben Ali. Team: Lucerne Operations. Budget: 50000 EUR. Expected delivery: July 15th 2026. Goal: modernize check-in system and guest-facing services at Lucerne Grand Hotel.

title: Lucerne Operations Quarterly Review
author: marco.rossi@alpenblick.com
content: Lucerne Operations completed 3 projects in Q2. Current workload is high. Sentiment survey shows 6.2 out of 10. Team morale is declining due to overload. Recommend reducing scope of the Guest Experience Initiative to protect team wellbeing.
